note: Cross-language parity fixture for the Lemma engine.
The engine ships twice: TypeScript in mcp-server/src/cards/ and Python in
sdk-py/artano_lemma/engine.py. Both are supposed to return byte-identical
verdicts AND byte-identical prose, so a consumer that diffs results across
the two implementations sees zero noise. Nothing enforced that until this
file existed: each suite tested its own language against its own output, so
the two could drift while both stayed green.
Every case below is run through both implementations and compared against
`expected`. A drift in either language fails that language's own CI job.
The cards here are deliberately synthetic and self-contained: this fixture
tests ENGINE parity, not corpus contents, so editing a real card must never
To regenerate after an intentional wording change, see parity/README.md.
Never regenerate from one language alone -- that blesses whichever side is

card.name: parity hypothesis fixture
card.proposal: Kinetic energy of a moving mass.

conservationLaws.statement: Total mechanical energy is conserved absent dissipation.

card.rationale: Fixture exercising every check class with everything resolvable.

checks.name: Hypothesis.dimensional_analysis
checks.detail: Derived from formula: (1/2) m v^2 [J] = L^2·T^-2·M matches LHS [E [J]] = L^2·T^-2·M

checks.name: Hypothesis.reference_corpus
checks.detail: All declared references resolve — 1 mustAgreeWith (parity-base), 0 mayContradict (∅).

checks.name: Hypothesis.limit_rest
checks.detail: Claim recorded: in the regime v -> 0, the proposal should reduce to E -> 0. Symbolic verification pending.

checks.name: Hypothesis.conservation_energy
checks.detail: Claim recorded: energy conservation — Total mechanical energy is conserved absent dissipation.. Symbolic / numeric verification pending.

checks.name: Hypothesis.derived_from
checks.detail: Hypothesis extends corpus card "parity-base" — link resolves.

expected.diagnosis: Hypothesis passes hard checks (dimensional analysis, reference resolution) but its limit / conservation claims have not been formally verified. Human reviewer or symbolic engine (SymPy/PySR) should close the open warnings before promotion to a verified card.

card.name: parity dimensional mismatch
card.proposal: Claims energy but the formula is a momentum.
card.rationale: The declared vectors agree with each other but the formula does not have those dimensions.

checks.name: Hypothesis.dimensional_analysis
checks.detail: Dimensional mismatch — the formula m v derives to L·T^-1·M, but LHS [E [J]] is L^2·T^-2·M. The proposed equation does not hold dimensionally.

expected.diagnosis: Hypothesis fails one or more hard cross-checks. Reject or refine before any human review — the cited contradictions point to either a malformed proposal or a corpus inconsistency that itself needs auditing.

card.name: parity self-inconsistent formula
card.proposal: A formula whose own terms carry different dimensions.
card.rationale: A sum of an energy and a momentum has no single dimension; the engine must report that as a failure, not fall back to the self-consistent declared vectors and call it a pass.

checks.name: Hypothesis.dimensional_analysis
checks.detail: Dimensional inconsistency — the formula m v^2 + m v adds terms of different dimensions (L^2·T^-2·M vs L·T^-1·M), so it has no single dimension. This is a defect in the formula itself rather than a limit of the derivation, so the declared vectors are not consulted.

expected.diagnosis: Hypothesis fails one or more hard cross-checks. Reject or refine before any human review — the cited contradictions point to either a malformed proposal or a corpus inconsistency that itself needs auditing.

card.proposal: Cites a card that is not in the corpus.

checks.name: Hypothesis.reference_corpus
checks.detail: Declared reference cards not in corpus: card-that-does-not-exist. Hypothesis cannot be cross-checked against missing references.

expected.diagnosis: Hypothesis fails one or more hard cross-checks. Reject or refine before any human review — the cited contradictions point to either a malformed proposal or a corpus inconsistency that itself needs auditing.

checks.name: USCE.convergence_observedConvergenceOrder
checks.detail: Observed convergence order 2 is within [1.8, 2.2], measured over 4 refinement levels (per-level: 2, 2, 2).

expected.diagnosis: The measured convergence order matches the order the card declares.

checks.name: USCE.convergence_observedConvergenceOrder
checks.detail: Observed convergence order 1 is outside [1.8, 2.2] (per-level: 1, 1, 1). The refinement study is a clean power law, so this is a genuine order mismatch rather than a noisy measurement — the method is not converging at the rate the card declares.

expected.diagnosis: The measured convergence order contradicts the card. A clean power law at the wrong slope points at the implementation, not at the measurement.

checks.name: USCE.convergence_observedConvergenceOrder
checks.detail: The refinement sequence is not a clean power law: per-level orders are 2, 2, 2, 2, -0.107, spanning 2.11 (> 0.5, the engine default, not declared by this card). The overall fit gives 1.7, but that number does not describe this data. A tail that flattens usually means round-off-limited levels at small h; a leading level that is off usually means the asymptotic regime had not been reached yet. Drop the offending levels and re-run rather than reading this as a verdict on the method.

expected.diagnosis: The refinement study does not support an order estimate — neither confirmed nor refuted. Inspect the per-level orders before drawing a conclusion.

checks.name: USCE.convergence_observedConvergenceOrder
checks.detail: A convergence order needs at least two refinement levels; got 1. Neither confirmed nor refuted.

expected.diagnosis: Too few refinement levels to estimate an order.

checks.name: USCE.convergence_observedConvergenceOrder
checks.detail: Refinement levels must have positive h and positive error to fit a power law; got (0.1, 0). An error of exactly zero usually means the exact solution was recovered at that level, which carries no order information.

expected.diagnosis: Refinement data is not fittable as a power law.

checks.name: USCE.convergence_observedConvergenceOrder

expected.diagnosis: No observedConvergenceOrder envelope on this card — the order was not checked.
